source: NACA RM L7D10 (Gardner 1947), NTRS 20050019331, figure 1 (blade-form curves), page 17 rendered at 300 dpi by naca-archive's debug-figs workflow. Traced with digitize_track.py (fig1_l7d10_trace_config.json); calibration from the frame and zero line: x 0 at 875.5 px, 1.0 at 1879 px; y 0 at 2246.5 px, 36 deg at 561.5 px (4 deg = 0.02 b/D = 0.2 h/b per 187.2 px). Check: theta-beta at 0.75R reads -0.001 deg.
propeller: Curtiss No. 838-1C2-18, three blades, hollow steel, with trailing-edge extensions (as tested), average design lift coefficient 0.5, diameter 12 ft 10 in, gear ratio 2:1, P&W R-2800-59, Republic P-47D-28
notes: Solid curves: blade with trailing-edge extensions (the tested blade); the dashed b/D is without them. The cuff (r/R < 0.32) is not modeled.
Twist and h/b are drawn to r/R 0.92; beyond it they are extrapolated in model.py. b/D is drawn to 0.98.
